name: nginx-multisite
description: Configures a multi-site Nginx web tier for three hostnames with HTTP-to-HTTPS redirects, virtual hosts, static content, TLS, security headers, fail2ban, firewall rules, sysctl settings, and SSH hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis logging storage, password authentication, configuration cleanup, and service enablement at boot.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys the FastAPI tutorial application from GitHub, installs Python and PostgreSQL dependencies, creates the application virtual environment and database identity, and runs Uvicorn as a systemd service.
